reference_prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Ripplet creature reference for a new image-to-3D attempt using the supplied established character image as identity reference. ONE full-body three-quarter studio view, same cyan aquatic otter/cat character, cream muzzle, eye surrounds, chest and belly, huge deep-blue eyes, broad dark nose, pink and cyan ear-fin fans, small cyan head-fin crest, forehead and chest droplet markings, chunky webbed feet with small dark claws and the broad cyan fin tail with pale curved striations. Neutral balanced upright standing pose, both feet grounded and separate, arms relaxed 25 degrees away from chest with separately readable shoulder, elbow, wrist and open small clawed hands. Tail curves gently behind and to the side, visibly separate from legs, entire fin inside frame. Replace projecting whisker hairs with three short fine PAINTED whisker marks on each cream cheek, flush with the muzzle surface: no physical tubes, wires, strands or narrow floating geometry anywhere. This deliberate reference adjustment prevents the previous generator's long whisker rods from crossing chest and legs. Keep all canonical face, ear, droplet and tail features. Sculpted fur masses with moderate clean detail, smooth integrated fins, coherent riggable anatomy. Light-gray background and neutral soft studio lighting, entire body in frame. No human, ruler, text, clothes, props, armor, particles, environment, red accents, extra limbs, dramatic lighting, cropped parts or thin hanging pieces.
